declaration.background: Schwarzschild exterior M=1 in ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates
declaration.domain: r>2 away from algebraic poles; omega is an exact indeterminate
declaration.sector: axial ell=2 with Fourier phase exp(+I*omega*v)
declaration.theory: strict linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity

does_not_establish: regularity at the horizon r=2 or at algebraic frequency poles
convergence of endpoint series or existence of endpoint flux limits
a horizon-to-infinity connection matrix or scattering matrix
mode stability, quasinormal-mode exclusion, CPT positivity, particles, or quantum unitarity

literal_current_reconstruction.interpolation_uniqueness: D*Jhat has radial degree <=29, so its values at 30 distinct radii determine it uniquely over QQ(I)(omega)
literal_current_reconstruction.method: localized-ring degree bound plus 30 exact rational-radius evaluations over QQ(I)(omega)
